main_body: sci-fi building with sloped metal roof and front facade
top_band: light blue-grey panelled roof surface with vents, rows 1 to 17
evidence: Rows 1-17 show the foreshortened sloped roof surface with rooftop vents; row 17 is a light grey front edge line; row 18-20 shows the eave and orange fascia; rows 21-44 show the front wall with recessed windows and sliding doors.

style.evidence: The candidate uses a pure black outline along the roof edges and base, large flat-filled rectangular panels on the roof (8x4 px blocks of single flat blue-grey), flat window glass, and much lower per-tile colour and texture density than the richly textured Beodeul reference buildings.
